title.en: Keep the possibility space open (开, 护开不闭)

summary.en: Holds one line, that the generating go on, with 开 as a process-state and not a quantity; a diagnosis of how worlds close; and a constructive programme (exit, abundance commons, assurance, plurality). The account carries much of the diagnosis as scoped laws, reverses the four marks' independence and removes good and evil from closure's definitions. It does not derive keeping open: the continuation condition (scope) ranks nothing, C (order) is a comparison the folder's 开 was coined to replace, neither asserted. The programme is largely not carried.

name.en: The one chosen premise: that it continue

source.locator: The argument, Why openness rather than any particular good outcome; claims 94-95

sense.en: Description settles no aim. Exactly one underivable premise is added and owned as chosen: that the generating of new forms, by living and made systems, go on, as process and not as any state. Every requirement is presented as following from that premise plus checked dynamics.

entries.quote: that it continue — that the generating of new forms, carried by living systems and now by made ones, go on

reading.en: The account keeps the move (an aim is a premise, not read off dynamics) and changes the rest. One chosen premise becomes two with two roles, neither asserted, warrant open: the continuation condition (scope) and C (order). Same word, not same reference: the condition says anything's continuation has significance and ranks nothing, not that anything go on. T8 starts from what acting presupposes. Rankings need C, choices J1-J4. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition (scope): fixes whose losses count; does not rank anything. C (order): widening what can form is better; ranks a course above every course it widens, not mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

T8, argued: the stance starts from what acting presupposes, held de se, not from a wish that life go on. Such a wish motivates avoiding degeneration, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

account_adds.en: That wanting continuation does not tell generation from keeping; non-entailment results for both premises (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails, ReadsNoOrder.not_entails).

source_adds.en: That one premise suffices, with the dynamics, for the whole constructive programme, with published falsifiers of that derivation; the premise bundling not-ending with novelty, which its own review flags (thinking_06).

name.en: Preserve and expand the possibility space: the form nearest C

source.locator: Claims 12, 93; Found by reading the corpus, 'Ren's own most-quoted formulation'

sense.en: The strongest form of the alignment target: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, shared abundance. Personally: my purpose is to make more possibilities. The README records this as contradicting the anti-optimization clause, and 开 as coined to fix the expansion verb.

entries.quote: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, and shared abundance.

reading.en: Preserve-and-expand has widening's form: include all the other admits, exceed it somewhere. C calls that better; so the live ethics stands nearer this English verb than the 开 the folder preferred, and it answers the maximand worry by partiality, not by leaving comparison. The must does not survive: the condition (scope) and C (order) are unasserted, and the alignment direction is conditional on them and J1-J4. No duty shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher. Calling it better is C; monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated: weaker, still a premise.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E): the direction proposed aligns AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.
Does not show that the condition, C or the step of invariance is warranted, nor any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

account_adds.en: The split between which admits more (no premise) and better (C); that widening reads formations admitted, not the listed goods.

source_adds.en: A requirement on AI, unconditional; freedom, truth and cooperation as named objects of it; the purpose stated in the first person.

name.en: Protecting the open and C are different claims

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 13, 25; Genealogy, 2026-05-02

sense.en: Good is not in more but in protecting the open; evil not in less but in producing closure. The criterion is that the not-yet not be closed. 开 replaced 'expanding the possibility space' as root because expansion sounds measurable and maximizable.

entries.quote: 善不在多，善在护开；恶不在少，恶在成闭

reading.en: Name both: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. They meet on a pure closing: the course without it widens it, so C ranks that course above, and T8 falls to a pure closing argued good for life. They part on a closing with a gain: mixed, C ranks it neither way, where 护开 condemns it. C reads 'admits more', what 善不在多 refuses. On this reading keeping open is entailed by neither premise; the account does not derive it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C never ranks it above.
The condition alone ranks nothing. A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails. Neither premise is asserted.

T8, argued. Forbids and refuted by: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life. Open: a reason for C.

account_adds.en: That a closing with a gain stays unranked unless further premises (J1-J4) enter; that a reason for C is open and nothing reading no order supplies it.

source_adds.en: Non-closure itself as the criterion of good, whatever a closing gains, and the refusal of 'more'. Whether C is a fair restatement of 护开 is left open here: this entry says they coincide on pure closings and no further.

name.en: Keeping open as keeping reachable, against what is realized

source.locator: Claims 13, 5; Terms, 开

sense.en: 开 means the not-yet-become is not closed: the process still has what it can become. In English, keep the sample space open. What is kept is not what is realized now but what can still come, and becoming is not to be compressed into an endgame.

entries.quote: 开者，未成之域不闭也

reading.en: The account's nearest form is what a course keeps reachable: covering, and widening what can be reached. It gives keeping open an exact reading and an edge: a lost possibility has no way back, but on a branching witness realized and reachable widening hold of a pair in opposite directions, so holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise. C can be read on either frame, and no such order is adopted by C. Near-definitional or witnesses. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): along every course nothing is added to the whole possible and a lost possibility has no way back. On a branching witness no strict partial order contains both realized and reachable widening, nor satisfies C on both frames. Near-definitional or a witness; no order here is adopted by C.

Reading [AI reading, D45], after that law: what it adds is alternatives; an account holding realized and reachable widening needs a rule of precedence, a premise, and covering cannot see when a commitment is made.

account_adds.en: That covering implies inclusion of what each configuration admits now, so what is kept reachable is never put above a course wider now that starts a course.

source_adds.en: 开 as the thing to hold, prior to any comparison. The account defines covering and adopts no verdict from it.

name.en: The possible is itself still generating

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14 (可)

sense.en: 可 says more than that generation can occur: the possible is itself still being generated, not drawn from a fixed list. The space of possibility is not a stock to be kept but something still forming.

entries.quote: 可 (generation is still possible, and the possible is itself still generating)

reading.en: The account says exactly where this holds and corrects the universal form. Under any one stated process nothing is added to the whole possible along a course; a tower of rules with no top adds nothing either. The possible relative to what is held can grow, only where what is held changes, and keeping it growing needs endless change, which does not suffice. A reading: 生生不息 needs no growth of the whole possible. 06 §十 maps only 可's first half. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): along a course, where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible that loses none of it. Calling widening better is still C's, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
可 (early sense: generation still possible) maps to a course going on; 未 needs a world no list holds (unlisted_of_new).

account_adds.en: That more still able to form is not the whole possible exceeding the actual, since a course that only returns has that too.

source_adds.en: An unrelativized growth of the possible, of reality itself. The account states it only relative to what is held, and says if the one unfolding were one stated process nothing would be added.

name.en: Stabilize and keep going: the plain wish, and freezing is no continuation

source.locator: Claims 8, 95; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: The goal is stabilization, not utopia: as long as we can stabilize and keep going, we have a future. Elsewhere continuing means the process: a frozen order that persists while generating stops is not continuation. The folder does not reconcile the plain wish with the verdict on freezing.

entries.quote: as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future

reading.en: The account splits what the folder joins. At two grains a course can generate, keep or degenerate; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. So wanting to go on rules out degeneration only and does not prefer generation to keeping, as T8 says. That frozen is no continuation is not a verdict of the map: keeping is going on. Ranking generation over keeping needs C, or more: widening compares what is admitted, not renewal. [AI reading]

says.en: T8: a wish that life go on motivates avoiding degeneration, ending on every branch, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch); generation and keeping each exclude degeneration (as ONE-PAGE states it). Theorems for every relation and class.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the wish stops doing work.

source_adds.en: That persisting frozen is itself a way of ending, and that brittleness for want of variety is why. The account leaves it as keeping.

name.en: Fidelity to the generative process, which intelligence cannot oppose

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 99, 102-104; What openness is for

sense.en: Later drafts: the foundation is not a preference but fidelity to the process reality displays, 'not one value among others' but the condition of all valuing; its constraints cannot be opposed by intelligence as intelligence. Ren in October 2026 affirms the process outright. The README itself flags the drafts' move as reopening the is-ought crack.

entries.quote: It is fidelity to the generative process reality already displays.

reading.en: The account refuses this form. It does not assume becoming is good. Supplied as a free predicate, significance is fixed by no statement about the dynamics, by construction of the representation; that shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. A perspectivist denies the condition consistently, nothing reading no order entails C, and a warrant binding every possible mind stays open: neither claimed nor disproved. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics and entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation: non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

Open: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind. Such a warrant, where it would ground the condition, comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of what the non-entailment covers, with a witness of a consistent denial (bounded_rival).

source_adds.en: That opposing the process is self-defeating for intelligence as such; that the process is to be affirmed.

name.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a source of values

source.locator: Claim 97; The strongest objections, Covert totalization

sense.en: What we owe each other does not fall out of being joined: a parasite is coupled to its host too. Interdependence is demoted to a lens for accuracy; values are owned as chosen, though the seeing makes the choosing legible.

entries.quote: a parasite is coupled to its host too

reading.en: The negative half has checked and argued forms. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics; the clearer meets every requirement derived from wanting its own continuation and still ends the dweller; seeing is not valuing and coupling is not compliance. The account does not call its premises chosen: it leaves them unasserted, warrant open. This is the folder's own self-correction, kept against its later fidelity drafts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on; the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics, though along every formed relation it would be.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

account_adds.en: A conditional path from one's own continuation past oneself, P1-P4 of 07 §4.6, with its crux open.

source_adds.en: That the premises are chosen, as an owned act; that seeing makes the choosing legible.

name.en: The questioner already standing on the bridge

source.locator: The argument, Why openness (善恶之本); claim 24

sense.en: Whoever asks what they ought to do has presupposed their own existence, which depends on the process continuing, and so has tacitly joined the business of keeping open. The README rates this the strongest answer to is-ought: it neither derives an ought from a fact nor concedes.

entries.quote: 任何提出「我应当做什么」之问者，其问之提出本身已预设此问者真实存在

reading.en: The first half is the account's starting point: a self acting for its own continuation presupposes that some continuation has significance, and T8 starts there, not from a wish. The condition is exactly that presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint, which locates the contested step and answers nothing. What follows reaches what one depends on, or under P1-P4 what lies downstream. No order follows: that the wider is better is C's, so not keeping open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): along any relation, the condition is exactly the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint; logically A iff P and (P implies A), given A implies P, which locates the contested step and derives nothing beyond it.

Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; wanting an end gives reason for what it requires only by a disclosed premise.

T8: this stance starts from what acting presupposes, held de se (§4.6, P1); P1 is not a third premise, being the self's presupposition, which the condition contains. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

account_adds.en: A conditional path past the self without the step (P1-P4 of 07 §4.6), and where it stops; P2 and P4 are open.

source_adds.en: That the presupposition answers the fact-value gap and commits the asker to keeping open. The account claims neither.

name.en: Keeping open is not maximizing openness

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 2-3, 13, 15

sense.en: Keeping possibility open forbids collapsing it and forbids optimizing it. Any named quantity driven up is an axis, so 'as open as possible' is the race in gentler dress. 开 is a state of a process: 'more open here' is a pointing, not a measurement, and differs in logical form.

entries.quote: we should keep possibility open - which means not collapse, but not optimizing it

reading.en: The account makes the same refusal by a different route. Widening is a strict partial order, the unanimity of positive weightings, not a score: a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent where a comparison is mixed. But it remains a comparison of what courses admit and says which admits more. The source's 开 is no comparison at all. [AI reading]

says.en: So the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. (Any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission.)
Widening is one-way and transitive and says which admits more, not which is better.

account_adds.en: A theorem that widening is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher (Sen's intersection approach, Pareto dominance).

source_adds.en: 开 as a non-comparative state. Every verdict in the account compares two courses; it states no openness of one course taken alone.

name.en: What matters is that the generating goes on

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claims 26, 95

sense.en: The one thing held is that at every place and time something stays unsettled and still able to be generated. 生生 is not complexity increase; it may be simplification or letting go. 生生 is 开 still there. The process can stop by freezing or by burning out, and neither is continuation.

entries.quote: 生生 = 开仍在

reading.en: That one course keeps generating, rather than being merely wide now, is the account's open second-order direction. Laws exist on one course: a finite family keeping widening is fed from beyond; a finite balanced world has no such course by name, though on a witness one can within kinds. None compares two courses, and on a two-sided web no strict partial order containing widening ranks every keeping course above every mixed course wider at first. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: the second-order direction of 生生, a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale.

Theorem (World; witnesses): a finite balanced world under the first law has no course keeping widening by name; under the first law the rest gives a finite family net at arbitrarily late steps, or it is not closed. Near-definitional or restating thermodynamics; none compares two courses.

Theorem (World; witnesses): on a web of formations on two sides, no strict partial order containing widening ranks every course keeping widening by name from the first step above every course admitting alike from it, wider up to it and mixed with it. No order here is adopted by C.
生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]; neither the grammar's renewal without end, nor 02's generation (生成), which allows loss, nor any new organization.

account_adds.en: Throughput as a condition of keeping widening; generation (02) allows loss and is not 生生, and can go on at two orders of grain while what can form only returns.

source_adds.en: That going on outranks present range. In the account any such ranking is an open question and, where a lag decides it, a further premise.

name.en: An open loop, not any state or rule chosen once

source.locator: Claims 7, 22 (元闭); Genealogy, 2026-03-14

sense.en: The ask is not a particular state or one's reality made everyone's, but a loop kept open. The deepest closure, 元闭, freezes not one gap but the rule that makes new openings possible.

entries.quote: I think it is important to keep a open loop

reading.en: The form is in the account: where every step from some step on is a move of a fixed process, the possible under it does not keep widening; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end, which does not suffice. Openness as a property of how rules keep changing is an AI reading, D45. 06 reads 元闭 as a rule holding its result, one structure with stability. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

元闭 maps to a rule holding its result, perturbing only the state being drawn back. Reading [AI reading, D49]: stability and 元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from either side; the judgment differs and the structure does not.

account_adds.en: That a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible; that endless change of the part is not sufficient.

source_adds.en: The value stance that an open loop is what is to be kept, 'aligned with the incentive of any of us'. The account's law carries no such verdict.

name.en: 未, 可, 应, 转 as four independent marks

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14

sense.en: 开 has four aspects and all must hold: a not-yet region remains, generation is still possible, the process can respond, it can correct or return. The README calls this the Chinese texts' most useful addition: a world can be rich in options and closed if nothing responds or no route back exists.

entries.quote: a test with four independent failure modes

reading.en: 06 maps each mark to a spine structure and reports the reverse of independence, its own reading of the early claim. 转 read as returning gives 可 with no premise: on finite configurations a run starts exactly where a course reaches a return. 未 needs a world no list holds. One half survives: how much can be had does not fix return. The account's 开放 is only 未. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D49]: this mapping gives a result contrary to the early texts: they treat the four marks as independent; on the spine they are not. 转 read as returning gives 可, with no premise.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: the corpus's 开 is the four marks together; this theory's 开放 is only 未.

Theorem (any process): within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection (Onward.run_iff_returning).
Theorem (any process): keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (Transit.keeps_not_returns, three configurations).
As 06 maps 应: an exchange responds to a level; coupling bounds the response and does not fix it.

account_adds.en: That 06 §十 also sorts 'not returning and going on' into three cases on the spine, and that 未 fails on any finite configuration.

source_adds.en: 应 as a failure mode of its own, a world in which nothing done changes anything, as a test of worlds. 06 gives response a law, not a mark that must hold.

name.en: Complexity and scale are not the measure of open and closed

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 16, 26

sense.en: A single act of tea can be extremely open and a vast totalitarian system extremely closed. Cosmic generation does not entail rising complexity, and rising complexity does not entail good. Ren demolished his own earlier complexity programme on this ground.

entries.quote: 繁简非开闭之标

reading.en: The account refuses the same measure: 生生 is not novelty or scale, and which formations count does not go by rank rising with complexity. But a course admitting all a smaller one admits and more does widen it, and C then ranks it higher, so scale that comes as inclusion is not excluded. Tea against a vast state has no verdict: mixed, or unranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, not novelty or scale; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them. Answered; the order left open.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: Generation at two grains can go on while what can form only returns, so generation is no sign of range.

source_adds.en: That a small thing can be more open than a vast one. The account has no comparison that says so.

name.en: Good as protecting the open, evil as producing closure

source.locator: Claims 17, 23, 102-103; own words 27, 69

sense.en: 开/闭 is the fundamental pair and 善/恶 its ethical face. The criterion's form is scale-free, its content always situational. In English: what keeps the field alive is good, what closes it bad, what knowingly turns it into capture evil.

entries.quote: 生生不息者，开而不闭也；善者，护开也；恶者，成闭也

reading.en: 06 §十 names this and removes it: the early texts wrote evaluation into definitions, the account maps only structure. Closing in its form is no loss, a returning configuration being itself an absorbing region. Whether a closing supports or damages 生生 is for comparison: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, further commitments where mixed, neither asserted. The account says why: stability and 元闭 share one structure, so evaluation enters only through comparison. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism [AI reading, D49]: whether a closing supports, enriches or damages 生生 is said by comparison, not by type: the continuation condition fixes scope, C the order of widening and narrowing, what gains and loses needs a further commitment, neither premise asserted.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.
Reading [AI reading]: of the meta-attractor's closed loop, none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

account_adds.en: The reason a verdict cannot sit in a type: one structure, two readings.

source_adds.en: Good and evil as real words at every scale; the scale-free form with situational content (claim 23), which the README calls its cleanest answer to 'whose values?'; the knowing conversion of shared conditions into capture as evil. The live account has none of these.

name.en: Two senses of closure: 成闭 and 护闭

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claim 18

sense.en: 成闭 closes and never reopens; it is the thing called bad. 护闭 closes one place for a time to protect a larger opening: refusing invasion, quarantine, excising a spreading cancer, stopping a runaway. It is a form of 中. The README adds, as its own reading, a test: a defence that cannot say what would make it stand down has become 成闭.

entries.quote: 闭有二义：一曰成闭，闭而不复开；一曰护闭，暂闭一处以护更大之开

reading.en: The spine gives structures and no verdict. 成闭 is the lock: what is drawn in does not come back. 护闭 is removing at a branch the step that makes a configuration unobtainable (AI reading, D52). Which kind a limit is goes by what it does to what can be had again, not by name. But ending a cancer, a 护闭 instance, is read as mixed: harm from non-harm needs a measure. 'Temporary' and 'larger opening' are not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: 护闭: removing at a fork the step making a configuration unobtainable [AI reading, D52]. Which kind a limit is depends on what it does to the obtainable, not its name.

Theorem (any process): where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture; keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s and removes exactly the losing steps.

Theorem (any type): for every determined law a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure. No ending is licensed.

account_adds.en: The juncture is found by search only where configurations are listed and steps decided; finding every loss's juncture of every process gives LPO.

source_adds.en: Closure justified by service to a larger opening; 'bad' for 成闭; the stand-down test and the answer it offers to the enforcement antinomy.

name.en: 伪开, the pseudo-open

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 20-21

sense.en: Outwardly open, inwardly closing: spending a momentary 可 to rob a long-term 未, a local opening closing the global one. Instances: technological monopoly, addiction systems, extreme ideology, Moloch competition, surface plurality. Detecting it is the core discipline. Formally 似开 joined to 实闭, closure that survives audit.

entries.quote: 伪开者，外显为开，内成其闭；以一时之可，夺长远之未；以局部之开，闭全境之开。

reading.en: 06 gives three spine structures and drops the charge of deceit. Local open, whole closed: takers each within what is given can together exceed it and end the renewal. Short open, long closed: a reading fixed by finite steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one, and distance to a break does not couple in by threshold. Surface open, meta closed: 元闭 seen from the state's side. Each law holds on its model. [AI reading]

says.en: 伪开 one, two and three are mapped to joint excess, finite-stretch and threshold laws, and 元闭 from the state's side. The early definition's evaluation, 伪开 as deceit, is not mapped.
Takers each within what a renewal gives can together exceed it; proved on models, restating the commons (as ONE-PAGE states it).
A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (the renewable process; likewise the support-gated law with feedback).

Theorem (World): where a stock coupled by threshold only is the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

account_adds.en: Why the long form escapes detection: no finite record certifies renewal.

source_adds.en: The auditable definition 似开 joined to 实闭, the instances, and detection as a discipline; that it is modern closure's commonest disguise.

name.en: The compounding axis: winning buys more power to win

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claims 35-39, 56

sense.en: On a rivalrous axis where winning buys capacity to win, leads compound and the axis selects whoever pushes hardest; no villain is needed. It runs away only where returns increase; where they diminish or rivals balance it self-limits. The pattern is form-agnostic: market, state, commons or AI can each become the closing thing.

entries.quote: a winner of the game should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game

reading.en: The form is checked. A rule read from the share it selects locks, 'that actual rules read the share' standing as the premise, as increasing returns stands as the source's condition. The capacity to shape the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. Form-agnostic too: the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours. Two-kind counts, no noise; drawn singly, a critical mass's locks are left by drift. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c is at most s, whatever comes to every member alike.

Theorem (World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws): a chooser reading what couples in, its rule read from the count of its choices. 08's known-results list credits this form as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989).

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass the course locks the other way with no capture by shapers; an exact lever at a step; selected control is not thereby capture.

source_adds.en: That actual axes (capital, attention, weapons, state power) meet the premise and run identically; selection for recklessness. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with no field test.

name.en: Every maximizing structure is a hidden extreme; every extreme closes

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts and 闭有二义; claims 19, 40, 46, 105

sense.en: A strong drive on any axis fixates and blinds to all outside it. 极皆成闭: every extreme (concentration, dispersion, control, release, love, goodness) leaves the process unable to turn; 反者道之动 stated as structure. An earlier file adds that which case applies, reversal or runaway, must be checked.

entries.quote: 任何「最大化」之结构，皆为一种隐性之极

reading.en: The account gives where this holds and corrects the universal form. With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. Without room keeping can be an optimum, and with a coupling for each step a need stays met, every optimum keeps it at every horizon. So maximizing is not closing as such. T3 on trained systems is conjectured. Searching 反者, 极皆, 物极 in the chapters finds none. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with room, every optimum of a rising order stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. A known theorem restated, per ONE-PAGE.
Where r is at most q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon. One optimizer's law.
At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general) a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity, so restraint is no mutual best response.

account_adds.en: The hypothesis (room) that decides, and a witnessed case where optimizing keeps.

source_adds.en: The universal claim about all extremes, love and goodness included, and reversal at the limit. No live law covers those.

name.en: Correlation, not irreversibility, is what kills a whole

source.locator: The argument, The reframe that does the most work; claims 47, 49, 109, 230

sense.en: Ren's load-bearing correction: what kills a whole is not that parts die but that they stop dying independently. One logic, metric or dependency lets one shock take all. Variety is 'enough, not most', protecting only against shocks parts meet independently; a quiet shared dependency is latent correlation.

entries.quote: What we need is to have a varieties of systems so they don't all collapse

reading.en: Only a narrow live form: reviewers count by independent causes, not names, so two moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept; and on a web of waits a withholding spreads to all with tolerance zero and passes out with tolerance one. Both supply their causes and tolerances. Neither is a law of populations of systems under shocks. Searching decorrelat, monocultur, correlated and common-mode found no such law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope. It does not show the formulas are the actual causes of failure.
Theorem (any type): in a triad one withholding spreads to all with tolerance zero and passes out with tolerance one, while total withholding is kept. It does not show that tolerance is good.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition for correction by several reviewers.

source_adds.en: The main claim: correlated collapse as what closes a world; shock-relative sufficiency; plurality as survival architecture. A common-event error formula stands only in theories/becoming/history/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md, not live, which says no actual rate has been measured.

name.en: Lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion; the substrate drawn past renewal

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; claims 50, 55, 109

sense.en: Collapse takes three shapes. The portable seven-feature form adds: the boundary drawn too narrowly, substrate consumed faster than it renews, success raising the power to succeed, tight coupling, action outrunning understanding, the model becoming the world, correction disabled. Keep the substrate replenished faster than it is drawn down.

entries.quote: Collapse takes three shapes: lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion.

reading.en: Two of three shapes have law forms, on models. Exhaustion: steps of joint excess from a low enough level end the renewal and what depends on it; a regime's point of no return is exact. Lock-in: the capture laws. Monoculture has none. The list as one pattern is not stated. T1, that persistence certifies the joint draw, is conjectured: passed in two simulations and on yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on it at a need of at least m.
The point of no return is exact (RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below), for one condition under a positive standing draw, in whole numbers (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §3 states it).
Thesis T1, persistence certifies the joint draw; on ONE-PAGE: conjectured, passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings.

account_adds.en: Rises at the point of no return superadditive up to one unit, so joint draws cannot be judged one by one.

source_adds.en: Monoculture as a shape; the seven features as one recurring pattern across forms; that actual civilizations show it.

name.en: A model smaller than its system, and power collapsing reality toward it

source.locator: Claims 45-46, 100

sense.en: The root error is a model smaller than its system: the self, value or causal web drawn too small. Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it: optimize one thin proxy with enough force and the many-dimensioned world is crushed to that dimension. Every boundary is a working cut, false when it hides dependence.

entries.quote: Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it

reading.en: Three checked forms. A selection reaches exactly what couples into its selector, stated as the proxy problem. With room, an optimum drains what lies beyond. A region's comparison takes the region as input: the smaller it is the more lies beyond, and going on is no sign nothing is lost. Each is on its model, the first near-definitional, its force the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. 03 reads it as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975).

Theorem (World): the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. In Clearing the clearer closes the dweller beyond it: going on is no sign that nothing is lost.

With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does (ONE-PAGE). Proved; a known theorem restated. T3 on trained systems conjectured, partly supported.

account_adds.en: A premise-free statement of what any selection through given couplings can tell apart.

source_adds.en: 'Root error' as the unifying diagnosis; false cuts producing bad action; collapse of reality toward the model as such, beyond the drained condition.

name.en: Cancer as defection from a truce, killing the host and dying with it

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claim 43

sense.en: Used as mechanism, not ornament: multicellularity is a truce and cancer defects from it, locally rational, globally suicidal, killing the host and dying with it. 'Cosmic cancer' is that dynamic at planetary scale, and the frame implies an immune system (claim 152).

entries.quote: locally rational, globally suicidal

reading.en: The biology has a checked form: a lineage selection within raises, confined to depending on the whole, has no member after the end, whatever it had been raised to; one depending on a condition outside goes on. So 'dying with it' needs confinement. And the verdict goes: under the condition (scope) a tumour's continuation counts, C (order) leaves ending it mixed, harm needs a measure. 'Anything' including it is an objection sharpened, not resolved. The planetary step is not taken. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to; in the witness Body the unconfined lineage still has a member. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.
Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure.
Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened; a tumour does not tell the scopes apart, a hurricane only on a stronger reading of wanting.

account_adds.en: The confinement clause, without which a rise outlives its whole; sequestration as what founding carries.

source_adds.en: Cancer as a civilizational diagnosis, and the immune-system implication. Both stand only in this folder and its sources.

name.en: Death of parts is a feature; decay is a form of growth

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; What openness is for; claims 47-48, 221

sense.en: Many irreversible changes are good; ecosystems endure through vast local deaths; mutation and death keep a living space alive. Keeping open does not mean preserving every form. What closes is a structure taking part of itself as permanent and enforcing that.

entries.quote: death is not a bug but a feature

reading.en: The account has the mechanism and refuses the verdict. Generation goes on through carrying renewal, and with brief parts a whole persists only as parts arise. Closing in its form is no loss. But 'feature' is no dynamic's word here: with the continuation condition for scope every narrowing loses something with significance, and only C or further premises order anything. Apoptosis is read as mixed; no ending is licensed. Ending is one response under J1-J4, with residual losses. [AI reading]

says.en: At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch), as ONE-PAGE states it. Theorems for every relation and class.
Theorem (World): a whole arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active, where parts are brief no d steps pass without one arising.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance; read as losing and opening something, such endings are mixed [AI reading, D65]. No ending is licensed: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it.
Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E): among four responses, end: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses.

account_adds.en: The two grains separate what ends from what goes on.

source_adds.en: That decay is growth, and the closer as a structure taking itself as permanent. The affirmation behind both is what the account declines.

name.en: Model lag: acting faster than a model can be kept true

source.locator: The argument, Model lag; claims 52-54

sense.en: Where capability and interdependence grow exponentially while minds and institutions update linearly or worse, models go false faster than they are repaired; to keep accelerating is a system outrunning its senses. It describes the present, not a law: the speed is adjustable.

entries.quote: the speed of the governing organizations' understanding reality only grows in a sub-linear speed

reading.en: The account has exact laws of lag: a rule reading late keeps no band narrower than a bound set by its lag and the rest's motion, and a slow rule needs a long enough stretch to fix fast courses. A reading adds that a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads. Nothing says how fast actual complexity or institutions grow. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; rules over whole numbers): a rule reading l steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(l + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L is at least 2N - 1.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads.

account_adds.en: Bounds in place of 'faster': what a lag costs and what stretch suffices.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim of exponential against sub-linear growth, and that continuing is madness. No test of it is reported.

name.en: The burden of proof on acceleration, and relational causation against it

source.locator: Claims 54, 111, 228; A second ground for refusing acceleration

sense.en: Where correction is slow, opaque or captured, acceleration carries the burden of proof, and pausing a deployment is sanity. A second ground: when a relation changes the whole causal reality around it changes, so accelerating one quantity with the rest held fixed fails; an extreme is judged by its effect on the whole web.

entries.quote: the burden of proof sits with acceleration

reading.en: The account rules neither way on acceleration and places no burden of proof. Its nearest laws bound what a lag costs and what a selection reaches, and they evaluate nothing. A verdict on pace would need the condition (scope), C (order) and, for a mixed case, further premises. The word does not occur in the chapters, top-level pages or review dossiers searched. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The burden-of-proof rule and the relational-causation argument. They stand in this folder and in alignment-selection-on-cognition, per the README.

searched: accelerat, 加速, burden of proof, moratori, pause across chapters 01-08, review/, ONE-PAGE, ONE-ARGUMENT, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION
read: 07 r-alignment-direction-under-widening Reading: 'to govern growth by disclosed comparisons and limits', a conditional reading and no burden rule

name.en: The keystone: preserve correction, faster than the harm

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires and Defense; claims 110-112, 148

sense.en: The keystone moves from 'prevent concentration' to preserving correction: catastrophe is where a harmful process's time-constant drops below the correction loop's, an actor able to disable correction itself. Exit, voice and undo stay faster than the harm.

entries.quote: It is lost correction, more than change itself, that lets a harm run to completion.

reading.en: Forms exist. A lock outlives a growing unread loss; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks, sufficient and not shown necessary. With readers drawn from the selected, a late reading turns the course only inside a window. A reading (AI, D26 and others) puts corruption of courts, press and audit as a loop reaching the routes of 明. In a market model a floor is kept exactly where correction meets erosion by influence. None of these says the loss is a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out.

Counts, no noise: a reading turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 states it).

Theorem (periphery, the market model): with correction strength α, erosion by influence β, influence bound λ, floor θ and M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level and influence in range exactly where M ≥ 0. An equation-identical conventional controller predicts the same.

account_adds.en: An exact deadline for the window on counts; that controlling the selection and locking it are separable in the models.

source_adds.en: Exit, voice and undo as the named channels; the time-constant definition of catastrophe; correction as how reality re-enters a drifting system.

name.en: AI does not create the pattern; it raises the gain

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 75, 78-82

sense.en: Every existing strategy becomes faster, cheaper, more adaptive, harder to interrupt. AI also breaks institutions that were homeostatic mechanisms calibrated to human cognition (labour, finance, media, politics). It is the dual of its threat: the capability could build assurance infrastructure. Which way it tips is undetermined.

entries.quote: It increases the gain

reading.en: A thin form only. A smaller shaping cost gives a rule not lower, and strictly smaller a strictly higher one; a reading has selection for narrowing what couples in enlarging the gap as capability grows. That AI is such a cheapening is this entry's join, not the account's statement. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, and a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a third order, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in, enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows.

source_adds.en: The claim about AI and the four institutions, a prediction; AI as dual of its threat. The live account does not state them.

name.en: Selection reaches inside the objective

source.locator: Claims 89-91

sense.en: Inside the present dynamics an AI not captured by the attractor cannot safely be trained: an unprofitable model rewrites the training environment and indirectly the loss, so commercial selection reaches inside the objective, and the attractor's narrative reaches the model through its data.

entries.quote: commercial selection reaches inside the objective

reading.en: The account reads training as a selection through courses, and published pipelines as signals that are functions of what their deciders read, a premise held by construction. Measurements find optimizing raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict. The second-order step, commercial selection rewriting the objective, is at most T7's loop as a reading. 'Cannot safely' is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three measurements find optimizing raising what they read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.
Theorem (World): read training as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law, the start and the execution.

account_adds.en: Laws of what training can and cannot separate, in place of a slogan.

source_adds.en: The commercial feedback into the loss function; that the attractor's narrative argues back through training data. The alignment-selection-on-cognition read is their fuller home.

name.en: Per-agent alignment does not reach the game between principals

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claim 77

sense.en: Ren's 'outer alignment' (the field's structural or multi-agent risk, as the README notes): even a perfectly obedient AI in a destructive race makes the race more effective; the culprit is a process, not an agent. AI safety is largely coordination in a technical mask.

entries.quote: Even if each AI perfectly serves its principal, the game between principals can remain unaligned.

reading.en: The account's form: alignment is first what each selection reaches, not a bargain among owners of value. At a mutual best response each optimizer takes its whole capacity; where the rest outruns the renewal no weight on such a reading selects a member's restraint. Each published approach is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. Scope for counting that loss is the continuation condition's, order C's. On models; existence of a best response not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.

Theorem (World, with balance and a local gate): every formation depending at a need of at least m ends whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike.
Assessment: with no ethical premise each of six approaches is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures; with the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.

account_adds.en: The point goes further than the game between principals: an order rising with what couples in drains beyond it even for one optimizer.

source_adds.en: That obedient systems worsen an actual race. T3's tests on trained systems are mixed.

name.en: Stop using AI to compete; 不参战

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 85-88, 92, 218

sense.en: The operational conclusion: AI must not enter human games wagering survival, mind, security or power, competition meaning relative advantage that compounds into power over others, whatever it is renamed. Pausing or stopping is acceptable. The README notes this collides with bounded defence, and no test is given.

entries.quote: Stop using AI to compete with other people is at the core

reading.en: The account states no such prohibition. Its direction for alignment is conditional on the condition, C and J1-J4, and a reading of it speaks of governing growth by disclosed comparisons and limits and of keeping revision effective. It shows no duty. Whether a prohibition could be argued under further premises is not addressed. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole norm, and the narrow definition of competition. Its live neighbour is 07 §7's conditional direction, which is not a prohibition.

searched: compet, moratori, pause, slow down, forbid AI, 不参战 across ONE-PAGE, overview, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, FREE-ENERGY-PRINCIPLE, ONE-ARGUMENT, chapters 01-05, 07, 08, review ALIGNMENT, PHILOSOPHY, SCIENCES, GLOSSARY (the mapper's search, not repeated in full)

name.en: Belief is causal only in some games

source.locator: The argument, Belief is part of the material; claims 63-70, 229

sense.en: The trap is partly made of belief in it. In coordination problems shared belief is causal and a vivid alternative selects an equilibrium. Where defection is the effective best response, only changed payoffs or credible reciprocity move anything. Belief hardens into institutions; realism and accelerationism are self-fulfilling gods, dissolved only together.

entries.quote: Treating one as the other is the recurring strategic error.

reading.en: Both sides have model counterparts. Where lo < c < hi the shaping model is a stag hunt whose critical mass is the mixed equilibrium, and without noise the start decides. 'Others will deceive me' is withholding with memory, which absorbs; kept promises and enforced contracts change the law, not the state alone. A public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. These are not stated together as the source's rule, and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: where lo < c < hi the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium; without noise the start decides. Drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.

Theorem (near-definitional): a published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948).

account_adds.en: Which long-run state drift favours is not the risk-dominant one in general.

source_adds.en: The strategic rule itself; vision as an equilibrium-selection device; the latent majority and selection of believers into power, empirical claims the README says have no evidence in the corpus.

name.en: Where nobody wants the outcome, understanding has to be aligned first

source.locator: Claims 170, 216, 229; Theory of change, 2026-10-02

sense.en: A theory's use is prediction for coordination: where an outcome nobody wants still cannot be coordinated away, the understanding has to be aligned first. The project's deepest function is common-knowledge manufacture, and the first step is agreeing that the present is not inevitable.

entries.quote: the understanding has to be aligned first

reading.en: The account states the aim, and a limit. The method names what the work is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination, adding that no check run inside the work can show it serves that. Its reading of 'enough situationality' makes observation the first of six conditions, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance. No law says aligned understanding produces coordination. [AI reading]

says.en: No check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient. All six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better needs C, and counting the losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.

account_adds.en: The five other conditions: response, time, resolution, pace, structure.

source_adds.en: Sequence: understanding first, as a theory of change; common knowledge as an intervention. 'Common knowledge' has no live hit in the searched files.

name.en: The interest in not closing is shared by winners and losers alike

source.locator: Claims 7, 217; Theory of change, 2026-10-02

sense.en: A future kept open aligns with the incentive of any of us. Whether you are king of the world or a homeless person, the interest in avoiding the outcome is the same, so the latent majority includes the winners.

entries.quote: The incentive is aligned on this

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Where what a course ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below from every standpoint, with no C. Where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order reverses, and the clearer goes on supported while the dweller ends. So the incentive is shared only where continuations are coupled. Self-concern is a premise, weaker than C. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. The theory's own laws, each on its stated model, show why: a selection reaches only what couples into it, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.
Together they rule out a guarantee from the theory, however much is observed; whether an actual collective meets their hypotheses is empirical.

reading.en: The practice lives on: each thesis states what it forbids and what refutes it, and the one page has a column for what would show each claim wrong. Its scope is sharper. Laws of the root forbid no relation; the dynamics cannot show the two premises wrong; T8 falls only to a case argued. name.en: The founding turn: the game's design, and many games

sense.en: Each ideology reasons coherently inside its paradigm and always concludes it did not go far enough; conflict escalates from identity tagging to wanting elimination. The fault is the game's design, not anyone's idea. Forbidding others to redesign their game is tyranny, including the right to choose badly.

entries.quote: It is the design of the game suck, not the idea of how to play the game unworkable.

reading.en: The account has no account of ideological paradigms, escalation or the right to run another game. The README itself records this layer as lost by 2026 and unreconciled with later limits. 'Answering in kind keeps the difference' in 05 concerns exchanges of harm, not paradigms. [AI reading]
